answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The orchard is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the shale. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, split across independent auditors, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain.
